notes.title: Update
notes.content: [p]-Difficulty levels have been added.[/p][p]-A lot of content related to ammunition and difficulty selection has been added.[/p][p]-Numerous minor fixes.[/p]

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
- Items in the backpack and pouch are now highlighted.
- The save system has been changed and "SteamCloud" is now working (old saves will stop working, but the save system will no longer change).
- The boxes for transferring items to the Hub have been improved (abuse will no longer work).

- In the next update, expect "normal" and "hard", as well as a bunch of new consumables.

notes.title: Pre-release update
notes.content:
- The "Extraction" system has been introduced, now instead of the main menu you have your own hub, you can take items from the main game to the hub and use them in a new game.
- In the near future, a bunch of weapons and items for them will be added, as well as the "Normal" and "Hard" difficulties (which not only complicate the game, but change a lot, for example, on the "Hard" difficulty you will not drop clips).
- After the release, the game updates will not stop, new levels will be added, as well as a new mode that will fully reveal the "Extraction" system.

notes.title: An update is in preparation
notes.content: Attention, in the next few days there will be an update that can break saving at checkpoints, so finish the game if you don't want to start over.

notes.title: major update
notes.content:
-Added a large sewer segment, completing the level.
-Reworked bullet spread system (semi-automatic weapons have no spread, automatic spread can change depending on the body kit and stock condition).
-Reworked loot system (now you can find many different consumables on the level).
-Zombies now have physics due to which they have more correct behavior.
-Doors can now be opened with a simple push (if the door opens away from you).
-The next update will be coming soon, it will add new weapons, new consumables, rotten zombies, and most importantly, a system for saving found loot in the player's main room (main menu room) will be added. At save points, you can transfer several any items (including weapons) to the main room and start a new game with these items for more severe tests in the "Normal" and "Hard" modes, which will be unlocked and available for passage.

notes.title: Meet "Putridness 2.0"
notes.content:
The technical side of the game has been completely redesigned:

-New core mechanics: now you have physical hands instead of interaction spheres, you can take any physical objects and your hands will correctly grasp them.

-The locomotion system repeats the system from hlAlyx, which is the best option.

-Realistic interaction with weapons has become even more realistic, the "GunPorno" element has become deeper.
-The inventory has also been completely redesigned, you still have a backpack and slots for weapons and unloading on your body, but all this now works neatly and conveniently.

-Options and a system for saving your progress have appeared (at the moment, one difficulty is available, but in the next update there will be 3 of them with the ability to take out and save items from levels to your hub like "extraction", and from the hub you can take items into the game or just collect them).
- New AI, zombies have become more dangerous and interesting, now they can shoot at you with a firearm, break down doors, spit and much more, they have a large number of behavioral models.

In the next update, expect a difficulty system, implementation of the "extraction" genre, more guns, new types of enemies, new levels (At the moment, one level is available, but since all the game tools are ready, the production of new levels will be fast)
